summary: E-Home Household Service Holdings, a Cayman-incorporated, Nasdaq-listed Chinese household services provider, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 29, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement for a private placement of 71,800,000 ordinary shares at $0.60 per share, roughly $43.08 million gross, with consideration comprising $1,000,000 cash plus 2,104,000 MFT tokens valued at $20 each, under Regulation S. Closing expected on or about October 15, 2026; no advisor, board recommendation, premium, or registration rights stated. This is a routine capital-raising share issuance, not a control or special-situation event; watch dilution and token-valuation risk.
